messages:
maya: Heads-up — quick benchmark sweep showed a weird p95-only spike in eu-west when requests get routed through edge-proxy-b. p50s are unchanged. Link to charts: https://internal.redwood/bench/1777654321 :eyes:
kevin: I saw that in the dashboard this morning. p95 in eu-west ~180ms higher than us-east for the same model/config. p50s match. :thinking:
olga: Do we have the exact model + quant config used for that sweep? int8 vs fp16 can change kernel choices and warmup behaviour.
maya: Using redwood-13b-int8 (quant profile v2), prompt length ~80, batch size 1, runtime flags: --kv-cache=auto --kernel-pref=auto. Repro command:```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-13b-int8","input":"test prompt","max_tokens":128}'
```
samir: Two quick hypotheses: 1) edge-proxy-b is selecting a fallback kernel path for some batches (we saw a similar atten-compat fallback add ~30-45ms), 2) socket egress/backlog on eu-west POP hitting a slow upstream. Also check whether batch fusion is disabled in that POP due to a feature flag.
kevin: I cross-checked deploy logs — edge-proxy-b had a config push at 2025-03-28T05:12Z that toggled connection_pool.max_sockets from 500 -> 200 temporarily. infra-bot recorded a transient restart around then. That could line up with the timeline.
infra-bot: [deploy] edge-proxy-b rolled config cfg-2025-03-28-05 at 2025-03-28T05:12:14Z, restart completed 05:12:23Z.
olga: Good catch. If max_sockets got squeezed we can see tail latency rise without affecting p50. Should reproduce by forcing socket limit locally.
maya: For next steps I'll run a controlled sweep across us-east/us-west/eu-west with: redwood-13b-int8 and redwood-13b-fp16, batch sizes [1,2,4], with/without KV priming, and kernel-pref=auto vs kernel-pref=force_fast. Will collect p50/p95/throughput and kernel histograms. Posting results as CSV later.
kevin: If you need a quick check, try forcing routing to region_local in the request to see if p95 drops. When I forced region_local for a small batch p95 in eu-west dropped ~150ms.
maya: Good idea — doing that now.
maya: Quick interim: forced region_local for the same payload -> p50 ~38ms (same), p95 -> 96ms (was ~270ms when routed through edge-proxy-b).
samir: That strongly suggests the edge-proxy path is the culprit. Also try enabling KV cache priming before the sweep (prime with short prefix) to rule out warmup effects.
olga: I'll run the perf harness in eu-west on a h100 node and attach logs. If kernel fallback is the trigger we should see different kernel names in the per-token timing histogram.
maya: Thanks — filing a short ops ticket and adding results: https://internal.redwood/issue/RED-4321. Volunteers to help with a binary search across proxy config flags? :thumbsup:
kevin: I'll help with the socket limit experiments and replay traffic.
samir: I'll look into the kernel selection heuristics and whether quant-profile v2 maps to atten-compat in edge POPs.
olga: On it, will upload logs to the ticket when done.
maya: Cool — keeping this thread for updates. If anyone sees similar geo-only p95 spikes elsewhere, drop a note here.
